newsitem.title: USA: Allegheny Power results hurt by mild weather.
newsitem.headline: Allegheny Power results hurt by mild weather.

text.p: Allegheny Power System Inc on Thursday said a decline in second-quarter earnings to $0.42 per share from $0.44 a year earlier reflected a 27 percent drop in June cooling degree days.

The cooler weather during the air conditioning season was largely responsible for a three percent decrease in kilowatt-hour (kWh) sales to residential customers during the quarter, the company said in a statement. Commercial and industrial kWh sales rose slightly for the quarter.
For the first half, it said earnings rose to $1.06 a share from $0.87 in the year-earlier period after an asset write-off of $38.7 million, or $0.32 cents a share.
The decrease in year-to-date earnings, excluding special items, was primarily because of lower kWh sales.

The company said residential sales decreased seven percent because of mild winter weather in the first quarter as well as the cool June weather. Commercial and industrial sales were down slightly for the period.
Allegheny Power's utility subsidiaries serve about 1.4 million customers in Maryland, Ohio, Pennsylvania, Virginia and West Virginia.
